description: This file defines the 'Filter' class used for pattern matching and filtering strings based on include/exclude rules, with support for full and prefix patterns. It is part of the mkstubs tool in the Android build environment.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: A class that manages inclusion and exclusion patterns to determine whether strings should be accepted based on various full and prefix patterns.

methods.name: getIncludeFull
methods.description: Returns the set of all full inclusion patterns.

methods.name: getIncludePrefix
methods.description: Returns the set of all prefix inclusion patterns.

methods.name: getExcludeFull
methods.description: Returns the set of all full exclusion patterns.

methods.name: getExcludePrefix
methods.description: Returns the set of all prefix exclusion patterns.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Determines whether a given string passes the inclusion/exclusion rules based on full and prefix matches.
